We surveyed 800 US adults in June about the Harvest Crunch oat bar concept.

Intent falls steadily with age, as the table shows.
What the data shows
Adults 18–34 lead at 42%, 28 points above the 18% for adults 55+.
Adults 35–54 sit close to the overall average at 31%.

Fieldwork cost $9,600 with PanelNorth, at $12 per respondent.

Online panel: lowest cost per complete and the tightest margin of error, but it under-represents shoppers who rarely go online.

artifact.title: Harborline Boat Rentals: Spring Advertising Needs Assessment

segments.text: Purpose
This assessment identifies where Harborline should place its $35,000 spring advertising budget, based on last season's lead results.
Each channel was compared on spend, leads and cost per lead (CPL).
Findings
Paid search was the cheapest source of leads at $30 each and produced 56% of all leads.
Radio took the largest share of spend ($12,000), but its CPL of $80 is well above the blended CPL.
Social ads delivered 120 leads at $50 each, half the CPL of direct mail.
The National Marine Marketing Index puts the average CPL for boat rental firms at $45, so every channel except paid search is above benchmark.
Recommendation
Direct mail has the highest CPL at $100, so we recommend adding $4,000 to it to bring down our blended CPL.
Fund the increase by trimming radio from $12,000 to $8,000.
Keep paid search and social ads at last season's levels.
With this mix, Harborline is guaranteed to fill every weekend slot by June.
Next step: Dana approves the plan by March 1 so creative can be booked.
